title: Edge1 Security Service Console
interaction_principles: Show the expected effect before an action is submitted.
Require explicit confirmation for every mutating action.
Show progress, result, evidence identifier, and recovery guidance.
Never expose API signatures, secrets, command lines, or raw privileged output to browser JavaScript.
Fail closed when authentication, authorization, audit, or action state is unavailable.

actions.label: Check the security configuration
actions.description: Tests the Suricata configuration without changing the running service.
actions.failure_message: The configuration needs attention. No running service settings were changed.

actions.label: Load updated detection rules
actions.description: Asks the managed Suricata service to load reviewed rule updates without restarting packet capture.
actions.success_message: The managed sensor accepted the rule reload request.
actions.failure_message: The rule reload did not complete. The console will preserve and display the evidence record.

actions.label: Rotate security logs now
actions.description: Closes the current metadata log files and starts fresh files under the approved retention policy.
actions.failure_message: Log rotation did not complete. Existing logs remain available for investigation.

future_actions.label: Restart the managed sensor
future_actions.reason_deferred: Requires a dedicated allowlisted action, capture continuity checks, and automatic post-restart acceptance.

future_actions.label: Update detection rules
future_actions.reason_deferred: Requires a signed or pinned rule source, staged validation, diff review, rollback, and evidence retention.

future_actions.label: Manage retention
future_actions.reason_deferred: Requires storage forecasting and a reviewed metadata and PCAP retention policy.

required_browser_controls.authentication: OpenID Connect authorization-code flow with PKCE and MFA
required_browser_controls.session: Server-side session with opaque browser identifier
